forum.title: ZVF411 Data Sheet Please?
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @cornpone47, to the community!

the marking is 2902 which stands for the [LM2902](https://www.st.com/en/amplifiers-and-comparators/lm2902.html).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text: I am trying to find some information on an ancient (2002?) STMicroelectronics surface-mounted device.  It has14 pins and is labeled "ZVF411."  It is used in a PC board that controls three automotive gauges in a Chevrolet SSR.  I have tried searching the internet, to no avail.  Can someone help me, please?![20260327_195005.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/af94ed5b-7157-601e-5502-97788cc2bb9a.jpg "20260327_195005.jpg")
